description: This file implements a JSON parsing and serialization library using Qt framework, providing functions to parse JSON strings into QVariant hierarchies and serialize QVariant data back into JSON format. It includes internal static functions for tokenizing and parsing JSON components, as well as template functions for serializing maps and lists.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a QVariant hierarchy, returning success status via reference.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a QVariant into a JSON-formatted QByteArray.

methods.name: serializeStr
methods.description: Converts a QVariant into a JSON string.

methods.name: setDateTimeFormat
methods.description: Sets the format string for serializing DateTime objects.

methods.name: setDateFormat
methods.description: Sets the format string for serializing Date objects.

methods.name: getDateTimeFormat
methods.description: Returns the current DateTime format string.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Returns the current Date format string.
